title: Fossil Finder A-Z
hook: Build only the part of the past the evidence can hold.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: warm 3D fossil-and-bones storybook, sandy museum dig palette, friendly specimens, clean separable foregrounds

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child learning how paleontologists infer from incomplete evidence
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: patient 4/4 dig-site pulse with evidence pauses
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written evidence type plus taxonomic fact
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: evidence cue -> recall beat -> target -> brush/point/compare gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a tiny brush-shaker sweep followed by a glockenspiel fossil sparkle.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a tiny brush-shaker sweep followed by a glockenspiel fossil sparkle
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Fossil Finder an evidence reconstruction song: footprint, rib, bone, plant fossils and partial skeletons each answer different questions, and reconstruction uncertainty is part of the lyric.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child fossil worker moves from trace to bone to skeleton to interpretation, repeatedly asking what the evidence can and cannot tell us.
forbiddenGenericLanguage: build the past bone by bone
